old_reading: Ana checks the departure board.
The train schedule shows two trains.
One train leaves at seven.
The other train leaves at eight.
Ana wants the first train.
old_dialogue: What time is the next departure?
The next train leaves at seven.
Is it on time?
Yes. The board says it is on time.
When is the next train after that?
It leaves at eight.
Can I take the seven o’clock train?
Yes, you still have ten minutes.
